test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Provisions of the Indian Constitution is taken from the US Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Post of vice president.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision of the post of **vice president** in the Indian Constitution is taken from the **US Constitution.**
 
• The vice president of India is the** second-highest constitutional office** in the country and is elected indirectly by an **Electoral College** consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
 
• The **US Constitution** also provides for a vice president who serves as the second-in-command to the **President **and is elected through a similar Electoral College system.
 
• The Indian Constitution also draws inspiration from other constitutions, such as the **British Constitution, the Irish Constitution, and the Australian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental duties** are a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that was added through the **42ⁿd Amendment in 1976.**
 
• It imposes certain obligations on citizens to uphold the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India, and to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood among all people.
 
• **The procedure for amendment of constitution **is also a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that outlines the steps required to amend the Constitution.
 
• It requires a special majority of both houses of Parliament, as well as** ratification **by at least half of the state legislatures.
 
• **Bicameralism **refers to the division of the legislature into two houses - the **Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha** in the case of India.
 
• This is not a provision that is taken from the **US Constitution**, as the US has a unicameral legislature consisting of a single House of Representatives and a Senate.
